answers.answer: The draw deck contains the player's 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards shuffled together. Put 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine spot, set the Gear pawn to 1st gear, and draw 7 cards into hand.
answers.evidence: Setup: steps 3–6 and 9.

answers.answer: Yes, you may stay in your current gear. Shifting from 1st to 3rd is a two-position shift and costs 1 Heat, paid immediately during Shift Gears by moving a Heat card from your Engine to your discard pile. You must have that Heat available.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure, Simultaneous Phase: Shift Gears.

answers.answer: No. In 3rd gear you must play 3 cards, and you play them face down.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure, Simultaneous Phase: Play Cards: 'equal to your gear number' and cards are played 'face down.'

answers.answer: Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous for all players, in that order. Everyone must finish both before step 3 starts. Steps 3–9 are then sequential: one player completes all of them before the next player begins. A side-by-side car closest to the Race Line is ahead and acts first.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure: Simultaneous Phase and Sequential Phase.

answers.answer: Cars do not block passage. If the destination space is full, put your car in the first free spot behind the blocking cars. Prefer the spot closest to the Race Line if it is available.
answers.evidence: Special Rules & Edge Cases, Blocked Movement; Reveal & Move.

answers.answer: Discard the flipped Heat card and Starting Upgrade card immediately as non-Speed cards. Put the revealed Speed 3 card on top of the played Stress card in the Play Area; that Speed 3 supplies the Stress card's speed. The played Stress stays underneath and both are discarded during Replenish Hand. Resolve all played Stress cards before moving on to Adrenaline.
answers.evidence: Stress Cards: discard each flipped non-Speed card and place the found Speed card atop the played Stress; resolve Stress before Adrenaline.

answers.answer: With five cars that started the race, the last two cars to move receive Adrenaline. It gives access to 1 extra Cooldown and allows 1 extra speed. That extra speed may be taken before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved for another round.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: last two cars when the race started with 5 or more cars; 1 extra Cooldown and 1 extra speed; timing and unused benefit rules.

answers.answer: Yes. In 2nd gear you have Cooldown 1, so during React you may move one Heat card from your hand to your Engine. The summary explicitly permits cooling Heat from hand into the Engine and then immediately spending it to Boost, paying it from Engine to discard.
answers.evidence: Actions, Cooldown (2nd gear: Cooldown 1); React; Paying Heat and Boost.

answers.answer: You may Boost once per turn during React. It costs 1 Heat from your Engine, moved to your discard pile. You cannot choose to Boost if your Engine has no Heat available, though you may first use available Cooldown during React. Flip cards from your draw deck, discarding non-Speed cards until a Speed card appears; add that Speed card to your Play Area and move its value. Boost speed counts toward corner checks.
answers.evidence: Actions, Paying Heat and Boost.

answers.answer: Slipstream is optional. Check the corner using total speed 6, excluding the two spaces of Slipstream movement. Since 6 exceeds the limit of 4 by 2, pay 2 Heat if available.
answers.evidence: Slipstream and Check Corner: Slipstream is optional, does not increase speed for corner checks, but crossing a Corner Line still requires checking; pay Heat equal to the excess.

answers.answer: Check both corners in the order crossed, using the same total speed of 8 for each. Pay 2 Heat for the limit-6 corner and 4 Heat for the limit-4 corner, for 6 Heat total.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: check every crossed Corner Line in order, separately; compare total speed to each limit and pay the excess.

answers.answer: You owe 3 Heat for the speed excess, but have only 2, so you cannot pay and spin out. Move all remaining Engine Heat to your discard pile. Move your car back to the first available space before the corner that caused the spin out. Take 2 extra Stress cards directly into your hand because you were in 3rd/4th gear, then set your Gear pawn to 1st gear.
answers.evidence: Special Rules & Edge Cases, Spin Out.

answers.answer: You may discard unwanted Speed cards, but not Stress or Heat cards. You may not browse any discard pile, including your own; only the top card of each pile is public knowledge.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure, Discard.

answers.answer: Move all Play Area cards to your discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand back to 7; do not draw seven additional cards.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure, Replenish Hand.

answers.answer: Shuffle your discard pile into a new draw deck, without including cards still in your Play Area, then continue the interrupted Stress flips. The empty-deck rule applies during Stress, Boost, and Replenish Hand.
answers.evidence: Special Rules & Edge Cases, Running Out of Cards.

answers.answer: When paying Heat, move Heat from your Engine to your discard pile. Heat later moves from discard to draw deck to hand, and returns to the Engine only through Cooldown. You may not normally play or voluntarily discard Heat from your hand; the summary describes a forced Cluttered Hand exception.
answers.evidence: Actions, Paying Heat; Special Rules & Edge Cases, Heat Card Cycle and Heat card restriction.

answers.answer: Commit both playable cards and fill the other two required slots with Heat cards from hand in the Play Area. Your car moves zero spaces. Set your gear to 1st, discard all committed cards including the covering Heat cards, and skip directly to step 9. You skip React, so you cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn.
answers.evidence: Special Rules & Edge Cases, Cluttered Hand.

answers.answer: The summary does not say that the car that crossed first automatically wins. If multiple cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins, with the spot closest to the Race Line breaking ties. At the end of the round, remove all cars that crossed the final finish line and place them in finishing order on the Hall of Fame.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: same-round finish and end-of-round handling.

answers.answer: No. On the final lap, you cannot Slipstream across the finish line, and cannot Slipstream after crossing it. After crossing the final finish line, ignore speed limits of corners beyond it and move as far as you can.
answers.evidence: Slipstream and Scoring / Victory Conditions, final-lap rules.

answers.answer: Both remaining cars receive Adrenaline. The number of cars that started the race determines eligibility: because six started, the last two cars to move receive the benefits even after four have finished.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline and Scoring / Victory Conditions: use the number of cars that started, even after finishers leave the track.
